en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
It's hard to decide what to watch
Play dominoes with the movie boxes
We should focus on reality, not movies

On my island, that kinda indecision can get
you killed.

Even the slightest hesitation can mean your
doom.
Hmm? Is that some kinda ritual?

Why don't we use children as dominoes, instead?
That would make Atua much happier.

And when the children all fall down, Atua
will have Himself a good laugh!

Exactly, Shuichi! Movies are fun and all,
but I prefer real life.

After all, movies only show stuff that can't
be seen in real life.

If there was a camera that could record Atua,
I would show it to everyone.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Angie looks deep in thought...
